text:
ITEM 1 | Fresh spinach leaves, dark green, glossy and wilted in places, with thin stems, tossed with dried cranberries (small dark red pieces) and thin orange shreds (carrot-like matchsticks), sitting in a light sheen of dressing, on the upper left of the plate covering about 25% of the plate area, roughly 3 cm tall in a loose mound | 110
ITEM 2 | Golden-yellow roasted potato chunks, about 2-3 cm cubes with browned, crisp edges and soft interiors, some with dark charred bits, arranged in a cluster on the upper right covering about 15% of the plate, about 2 cm high | 130
ITEM 3 | Dark green wilted leafy vegetable pieces mixed among the potato chunks, glossy and slightly charred at the edges, a small amount covering about 3% of the plate, flat and thin | 15
ITEM 4 | Shredded brown-pink meat, moist and stringy, with darker seared chunks, piled in the center-right covering about 12% of the plate, about 2 cm high | 80
ITEM 5 | Sliced zucchini rounds and half-moons, pale green skin with lighter flesh, some grilled with dark grill marks, scattered among the meat and greens on the right, covering about 5% of the plate, about 0.5 cm thick | 40
ITEM 6 | Fresh arugula leaves, bright green, ruffled and flat, lying loosely on the lower right covering about 8% of the plate, about 1 cm high | 25
ITEM 7 | Thick tomato slices, bright red with soft juicy flesh and visible seeds, slightly charred at edges, lying in the lower center covering about 10% of the plate, about 1 cm thick | 70
ITEM 8 | Flatbread pieces, pale golden with brown char marks on the surface, dry and slightly chewy, at the lower left edge covering about 7% of the plate, about 1 cm thick | 45
ITEM 9 | Small scattered white grains, pale and fluffy, mixed under the meat near the center covering about 3% of the plate, about 0.5 cm high | 15
